_comment: Knowledge budget INJECTION cap derivation baseline (W1-T941, MASTER-PLAN 8A). Captured by running src/lib/digest.ts's measureKnowledgeBudgetPressure + deriveKnowledgeBudgetCap over the LEDGER UNION (resolveLedgerUnion, src/lib/ledger-grep.ts, W1-T1013) -- never the live state/ledger.ndjson alone, which carried 6 of the union's 295 matching lines at this capture and is the exact under-read W1-T1013 fixed. THE 2026-08-17 CAPTURE RECORDED AN ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE AND IS NOW SUPERSEDED BY EVIDENCE: it read spawnsMeasured 0 with null percentiles because no learnings.injected rows existed in a traversable ledger then, and it said in its own words to re-run the same two functions once spawn history accumulated. It has. THE 2026-08-23 RE-CAPTURE, over 20 archived rotations plus the live file (ok:true, unread:0, spanning 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-23): 293 learnings.injected rows, 133 of them carrying a non-empty dropped set, 1716 dropped id occurrences over 28 distinct ids, ALL 1716 resolvable against buildEntryWeightIndex over the 38-entry corpus -- so no dropped weight went uncounted. Dropped here means BUDGET-dropped, not relevance-dropped: selectLearnings fills up to budgetChars from the ALREADY-MATCHED set and the remainder is 'dropped' (src/lib/learnings.ts), so this measures budget pressure and nothing else. Pressure: p50 5472 chars, p90 6348 chars -- the median spawn discards three times the old 1800-char cap. Priced against the measured cache mix over the same union (cacheRead 4381391891, input 69100, cacheCreation 91904767 across 983 call lines, 979 of them covered), a 97.94% cache-hit ratio, recorded rounded to 0.9794 here. deriveKnowledgeBudgetCap therefore returns changed:true with deltaChars 6348, deltaTokens 1587 (CHARS_PER_TOKEN 4), and recommendedCapChars 1800+6348 = 8148 exactly -- no headroom padding, so this file is re-derivable byte for byte from the same inputs. FOR SCALE, NOT AS A SECOND ARGUMENT: 8148 is 0.55x the 14758-char active corpus, so the cap still selects rather than admitting everything, and the corpus-weight ceiling in scripts/learnings-budget-ratchet.mjs is untouched by this diff. WHAT WOULD FALSIFY A LATER RAISE: the same two functions over a fresh union. Never raise capChars without both a re-measured pressure figure AND a priced delta in this file's history, and never stamp a fresh capturedAt over spawnsMeasured 0 -- that asserts a re-capture that did not happen.
